verdicts.reason: Quote states a single alert fatal_fault via an alert sender; scenario check (trigger and observe alert) is suitable.

Quote states o_alert is 1 for one cycle per detected handshake; this is checkable every cycle from interface signals (alert_o pulse width, relation to handshake), so assertion fits. Scenario also useful but assertion is primary.

Direct signal connection o_alert_integ_fail == receiver integ_fail_o is checkable by assertion, but the receiver is internal; it is a connectivity statement best checked with both an assertion and a scenario driving a bad sender.

Quote says a correct sender never makes it 1; actor is the system/sender behaviour condition. Verifiable as assertion: with legal sender behaviour o_alert_integ_fail stays 0. Actor should be system (the wrapper output), not the source.
Quote states repeated fatal alert until reset after bus integrity fault; requires a stimulus sequence (scenario).
Quote states a write of 1 to ALERT_TEST.fatal_fault triggers one alert event; scenario.

questions.question: Does 'repeated until reset' in GP-5-05 specify a repetition period, or only that o_alert pulses more than once? Also, does the bus integrity fault alert persist through the ALERT_TEST path (GP-5-06 'one alert event' versus repeating)?
